title: 第1067章  不惜一切代价第1066章  联手一击
slug: 穿越大乾从病秧子开始蜕变
lines: 裂缝之深，之宽，足以容纳一位真神境强者的圣识穿过。
如一条通往新世界的狭长通道，裂缝边缘金色符文还在疯狂闪烁，试图自行修复！
但速度慢得如同蜗牛爬行，显然封印的本源已经虚弱到极点。
摩罗耶老祖抬手擦去嘴角上的暗灰色血迹，声音沙哑却带着压抑不住的狂喜，“裂缝……足以让圣识穿过。”
“只要圣识能过去，就能锁定那边的坐标，就能让大军找到准确的突破点。”
他没有丝毫犹豫，神念如同无形的触手般从他识海中涌出，化作一道凝实到极致的暗灰色光束，好似一柄无形的长矛般朝着那道裂缝猛然刺去。
墨渊狱主、噬魂帝君、无定形存在也几乎是同一时间催动各自圣识，四道圣念如四柄无形的利刃，同时探入那道裂缝之中。
然而，在那四道神念即将穿过裂缝、触及玄天大陆那边的瞬间……一股恐怖的力量从裂缝另一侧轰然涌来。
那股力量如万古冰川崩塌，如无数座山岳同时坠落，携带着一种让人灵魂深处都在颤栗的古老威压，在四道神念接触的瞬间将其尽数击溃。
摩罗耶老祖只觉自己的圣念如同撞上一堵无形的铁壁，一股剧痛从识海深处炸裂开来，让他整个人不由自主地向后仰倒，口中再次喷出一口暗灰色的血液。
墨渊狱主、噬魂帝君、无定形存在同样遭受重创，他们的圣念被那股力量如同攥住毒蛇般捏碎，识海中如同有万柄利刃同时切割般剧痛。
四人同时发出闷哼，身形在虚空中踉跄后退数步，面色苍白如纸。
而那道裂缝，在这一刻竟然开始以肉眼可见的速度愈合。金色符文如被重新注入力量般，从裂缝边缘缓缓向中央蔓延，那些被鲜血腐蚀的缺口一枚接一枚地被修复，裂痕正在一点一点地缩小。
“莫山？”
摩罗耶老祖猛然抬头，那双灰黑色的眼睛中如同有万年寒冰碎裂般炸裂出一道难以遏制的怒意，“你居然还活着！”
他的声音在虚空中炸裂开来，每一个字都蕴含着无法言喻的杀意与惊怒。
方才那一瞬间神念被击溃时，他清晰地感知到那股力量的来源……
那是圣教最后一位大长老的气息，是上古大战中那个以一人之力、挡住异族三路大军长达数月之久的男人。
他本该已坐化，本该已化为尘土，可那道气息中蕴含的意志，那种如同万年枯木般的坚韧，却与记忆中的那个身影完美重合。
墨渊狱主同样面色铁青，暗金色火焰的眼中浮现出一种前所未有的杀意，“莫山……当年的圣教大长老，他居然复苏了？”
“这怎么可能？当年那般严重的伤势，即便是未陨落……也不可能还有复苏的可能！”
噬魂帝君重新聚拢的水银身躯表面、无数面孔同时浮现出一种复杂的神情。
有愤怒，有忌惮，也有一丝连他自己都不愿承认的惧意。
上古大战中，他曾在莫山手下吃过一次大亏，差一点被其以袖里乾坤完全镇压。

;;
The crack is deep and wide enough to allow the holy consciousness of a true god realm powerhouse to pass through.
Like a long and narrow passage leading to a new world, the golden runes on the edge of the crack are still flashing crazily, trying to repair themselves!
But the speed was as slow as a snail crawling. It was obvious that the origin of the seal was extremely weak.
Ancestor Moro Ye raised his hand to wipe away the dark gray blood on the corner of his mouth, his voice was hoarse but filled with irrepressible ecstasy, "The crack... is enough for the holy consciousness to pass through."
"As long as the holy consciousness can pass through, the coordinates over there can be locked, and the army can find the accurate breakthrough point."
He didn't hesitate at all. His spiritual thoughts surged out from his sea of consciousness like invisible tentacles, turning into a dark gray beam of light that was condensed to the extreme, and stabbed towards the crack like an invisible spear.
The Prison Master Moyuan, the Soul-eating Emperor, and the amorphous existence also activated their holy consciousness almost at the same time. The four holy thoughts were like four invisible sharp blades, and they penetrated into the crack at the same time.
However, at the moment when the four spiritual thoughts were about to pass through the crack and touch the side of Xuantian Continent...a terrifying force surged from the other side of the crack.
That force was like the collapse of an eternal glacier, like countless mountains falling at the same time. It carried an ancient coercion that made people tremble deep in their souls, and defeated them all the moment the four spiritual thoughts came into contact.
Ancestor Moro Ye felt that his holy thoughts were like hitting an invisible iron wall, and a sharp pain exploded from the depths of the sea of ​​consciousness, making him fall back involuntarily, and another mouthful of dark gray blood spurted out from his mouth.
The Prison Master of Mo Yuan, the Soul-eating Emperor, and the amorphous being also suffered heavy losses. Their holy thoughts were crushed by the force like a poisonous snake, and the sea of ​​consciousness was in severe pain as if thousands of sharp knives were cutting at the same time.
The four people groaned at the same time, staggering back a few steps in the void, their faces as pale as paper.
And that crack began to heal at a speed visible to the naked eye at this moment. The golden runes slowly spread from the edge of the crack to the center as if they were re-infused with power. The gaps corroded by blood were repaired one by one, and the cracks were shrinking little by little.
"Mo Shan?"
Ancestor Moroye suddenly raised his head, his gray-black eyes bursting with uncontrollable anger as if tens of thousands of years of ice were shattering, "You are actually still alive!"
His voice exploded in the void, and every word contained unspeakable killing intent and anger.
When his spiritual thoughts were defeated at that moment, he clearly sensed the source of that power...
That was the aura of the last great elder of the Holy Religion, the man who single-handedly blocked the three armies of aliens for several months in the ancient war.
He should have sat down, should have turned into dust, but the will contained in that breath, the tenacity like a dead tree that has been dead for ten thousand years, perfectly coincided with the figure in his memory.
Prison Master Mo Yuan also looked livid, and an unprecedented murderous intent appeared in his eyes of dark golden flames, "Mo Shan... the great elder of the Holy Religion back then, he actually revived?"
"How is this possible? With such serious injuries, even if he is not dead... there is no possibility of recovery!"
A complex expression appeared on the surface of the Soul-Eating Emperor's reunited mercury body and on countless faces at the same time.
There was anger, fear, and a trace of fear that even he didn't want to admit.
In the ancient war, he once suffered a big loss at the hands of Mo Shan, and was almost completely suppressed by Mo Shan's Secret of the Universe.
